_about: Jessie L. Weston's (1850-1928) English versions of medieval romance: Parzival (Wolfram von Eschenbach, 2 vols.), Morien, Sir Gawain and the Lady of Lys, Sir Gawain and the Green Knight retold, and four lais of Marie de France and others. She is the translator. Clean Gutenberg text; public domain. Her scholarly studies (From Ritual to Romance and others) are not taken. This shelf could as well be Lane C's: veto or move. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).

weston-parzival-1: Parzival: A Knightly Epic, Wolfram von Eschenbach, tr. Jessie L. Weston, vol. 1
weston-parzival-2: Parzival: A Knightly Epic, Wolfram von Eschenbach, tr. Jessie L. Weston, vol. 2

weston-four-lais: Guingamor, Lanval, Tyolet, Bisclaveret: Four Lais, rendered into English prose by Jessie L. Weston
